name: Enma Rin
source:
Died at the age of 19.

After she died, she wandered aimlessly until she was taken in by [url=https://vndb.org/c107327]King Enma[/url], and was raised as his daughter. A novice Hell Guardian with no memories of her past life. [url=https://vndb.org/c103295]Tamao[/url], who is also a Hell Guardian in training, is always by her side.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/rin/]Aksys Games[/url]]
